executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: The proposed native sequence guarantees do not yet extend to task-level evidence, recovery policy, or protocol selection.
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Require positive, task-bound guidance completion and make takeover terminal before extending the native timeline.

scope.target_name: Tro CursorCompanionGuidanceSpec.md, with current Tro worker and native patch as integration evidence

findings.title: Teaching success does not require a completed demonstration
findings.mechanism: A task with no preview leaves readIssue() null and can return completed. Separately, a satisfied verify_state clears guidance_failed even without a subsequent successful preview.
findings.source_layer: 6 tool selection; 7 tool execution; 8 tool interpretation
findings.root_cause: The evidence tracker records negative issues rather than independent positive teaching evidence; the spec defines native completion but leaves the task completion gate unspecified.
findings.recommended_fix: Define guidance-required and explanation-only outcomes explicitly. For a demonstration-required task, require validated successful preview evidence bound to that task. Track action verification independently; verify_state must not clear a guidance failure.

findings.title: Student takeover can trigger another guide through recovery
findings.mechanism: Native cancellation ends one sequence, but does not inherently abort the SDK task. The model can call another preview in the same run, and guidance_failed also triggers the runner's generic five-turn continuation.
findings.root_cause: Cancellation is defined at sequence scope without a typed task outcome, retry classification, or latched presentation admission after takeover.
findings.recommended_fix: Propagate typed cancellation reasons; latch the task epoch as canceled, reject further presentation calls for that epoch, and skip repair/model continuation for takeover or Stop. Replaying requires a new user instruction. Bound and expose any explicitly recoverable retry.

findings.title: The model can omit V2 and select legacy cancellation behavior
findings.mechanism: The spec defaults an omitted presentation_version to V1. Capability support checks do not ensure that a particular request uses V2; a model omission selects legacy pointer-movement cancellation and old choreography.
findings.root_cause: Protocol selection is left in optional model arguments even though cancellation policy is declared host-owned.
findings.recommended_fix: Bind presentation version to the trusted task configuration. Expose a V2-required schema to the agent and enforce it before dispatch. Reject mismatches or canonically inject the negotiated version; preserve V1 only for explicit legacy clients.

findings.title: A terminal receipt can acknowledge a guide whose cues were skipped
findings.mechanism: Elapsed-time sampling and latest-frame coalescing may skip the entire trace/hold under a long stall, while the final return frame is acknowledged and the sequence reports completed.
findings.root_cause: The spec guarantees cleanup and a terminal receipt, but does not define minimum rendered cue evidence or reading time.
findings.recommended_fix: Require step-tagged render evidence for the completed cue and a compositor-observed hold interval. Specify a progressive-render stall tolerance; fail and clear if it cannot be met within the bounded watchdog. Coalescing may drop intermediate frames but cannot invent successful presentation.

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Add task-bound positive teaching evidence and separate action verification.
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: The current gate permits skipped or failed demonstrations to become completed.
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: A task cannot report that it demonstrated something without a native completion receipt.

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Make takeover terminal across native, transport and SDK task layers.
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: An automatic continuation can restart guidance after the student takes control.
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Click/typing/scroll/Stop ends the current guidance task without unrequested replay.

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Enforce negotiated V2 in the trusted adapter.
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Optional model arguments can choose legacy behavior despite V2 capability support.
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: All new teaching tasks obey the reviewed motion and cancellation rules.

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Define per-step render/hold evidence and stall handling.
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: A terminal receipt alone cannot demonstrate that the student received each cue.
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Skipped teaching phases fail clearly rather than becoming successful playback.
